title: BeginnerSessionProfile
description: A small cookie-session profile API where users can sign in, view and update their own profile, follow local redirect links, and log out. Cookie sessions require CSRF protection on mutations, a local redirect allowlist, logout invalidation, and rotation of any supplied session ID.
generation_notes: Use cookie sessions for authentication and keep the workflow small: sign in, read profile, update profile, redirect, and logout.
Require a CSRF token on every state-changing mutation, including profile updates and logout.
Accept redirect targets only through a local redirect allowlist; reject external or unlisted destinations.
Logout invalidation must remove the server-side session so the old cookie cannot be reused.
Rotate any supplied session ID after authentication and reject malformed session identifiers with clear validation errors.
